MDIO_bridge_contract.polling: These bridge functions do not implement a visible explicit busy-bit poll or retry. Driver-level MDIO controller completion is a separate contract. Boot stages poll an endpoint mailbox through read32.
MDIO_bridge_contract.original_errors: Negative ioctl returns produce-1. In read32, the leading/trailing gate write results are not checked. Boot transfer loops also ignore many write32 returns. Native code must not carry stale data through those errors.
native_requirements: Prove the native mii_bus and route to address24 with board ownership established, not from interface name or a guessed external PHY mapping.

Stop at the first failed address/data/command/read, invalidate output, and attempt a controlled gate restore without overwriting the original error.
Apply bounded controller/stage deadlines and expose the exact failing transaction/stage without publishing device identifiers.

checksum.algorithm: Sum little-endian16bit words; if odd, add final byte as low byte of a zero-high16bit word; fold carry into16bits twice; bitwise complement and mask0xffff.
checksum.frame_scope: 32byte header with offset10 initially zero plus exactly declared data; excludes the transmitted extra2tail bytes.
checksum.verification: Old server checks only if received offset10 is nonzero; computes over32+declared length and requires result0. Zero bypasses validation.
checksum.whole_file: RRQ path computes a ones-complement sum over file bytes in1024byte reads, then copies resulting16bit value raw little-endian at header14 in every DATA response. This is not CRC32 or a cryptographic digest.
checksum.whole_file_accumulator_precision: The RRQ loop accumulates into a32-bit AArch64 w register with modulo2^32 wrap, without carry folding per1024-byte read. Final folds use arithmetic right shift. For large files this is not equivalent to a mathematically unbounded standard Internet checksum; preserve the exact verified algorithm when producing the compatibility field.
checksum.whole_file_reference: acc=u32(sum of LE16 words plus last odd byte); t=u32((acc&0xffff)+(s32(acc)>>16)); t=u32(t+(s32(t)>>16)); checksum=(~t)&0xffff. The checksum helper for <=8192-byte frames cannot substitute an unbounded whole-file implementation without matching these overflow rules.
